offers.title: Microsoft Ignite 2026: one free onsite Microsoft or GitHub certification exam
offers.description: Registered in-person Ignite attendees can take one eligible Microsoft or GitHub certification exam onsite at Moscone Center West in San Francisco. Seats limited. Not an online or remote voucher.
offers.eligibility: Registered in-person Microsoft Ignite 2026 attendees only; one exam per person; onsite testing November 16–20. Eligible exam prefixes include AB, AI, AZ, DA, DP, MB, MD, MS, PL, SC, GH.

offers.title: Microsoft Data Days: free DP-600, DP-700 or DP-800 certification exam voucher
offers.description: Data Days: AI @ Work offers a limited supply of 100% exam vouchers for DP-600, DP-700 or DP-800. Watch two qualifying sessions and score at least 85% on the relevant practice assessment before requesting a voucher.
offers.eligibility: Fabric Community account, two Data Days sessions and 85% practice assessment. One voucher per person, limited supply. Request by Dec 10, 2026; choose exam deadline Nov 30 or Dec 31, 2026.
offers.dateLabel: Request by Dec 10; exam by Nov 30 or Dec 31, 2026

offers.title: Microsoft Data Days: 50% off DP-420 and other certification exams
offers.price: 50% off eligible exam with approved voucher
offers.description: Data Days: AI @ Work offers 50% off eligible PL-300, DP-900, DP-420 and DP-300 certification exams. Join Fabric Community, watch two qualifying sessions and request a voucher. Limited supply.
offers.eligibility: Fabric Community account and two qualifying Data Days sessions. One voucher per person, limited supply. Request by Dec 10, 2026; take exam by Jan 31, 2027.
offers.dateLabel: Request by Dec 10, 2026; exam by Jan 31, 2027

offers.title: Pearson VUE free retake and eligible AWS exam discount
offers.price: 50% off eligible AWS first attempts; eligible free retake
offers.description: Opt in for the promotion. Participating AWS exams receive 50% off an initial attempt; qualifying programs offer a free retake after an unsuccessful first attempt. Check exclusions and code terms.
offers.eligibility: Opt in and complete first exam by Nov 17, 2026. Eligible certification programs and exclusions apply. Retakes Jan 4–Apr 7, 2027.

offers.title: ISA Black Friday: 25% off eligible OT security training and standards
offers.description: Code BFCM26 for eligible ISA training and ISA/IEC 62443 standards. Certification exams and study guides excluded. ISA members may receive additional member savings.
offers.eligibility: Nov 17–30, 2026; eligible products only. Code BFCM26. Not a free certification exam.

offers.title: Practical DevSecOps Black Friday certification program sale
offers.description: Discounted training and certification programs, including DevSecOps and AI security. Bundles advertise savings up to $600. Sale prices applied automatically; not a free exam.
offers.eligibility: Eligible programs and bundles; offer ends Nov 30, 2026 midnight Eastern. Verify checkout pricing.

offers.title: CSA Cyber Monday: 50% off eligible training and exam tokens
offers.price: 50% off eligible online training and exam tokens
offers.description: Cyber Monday discount for eligible CSA cloud, Zero Trust and AI security online training and certificate exam tokens. Join the official waitlist to receive the promotional code.
offers.eligibility: November 30, 2026 only. Waitlist/code and eligible products required. Paid exam at discount, not a free exam.
